exams.name: General Contractor Qualifying Examination
exams.notes: Examination covers practical application of contracting knowledge, plans/specifications, NC State Building Code, estimating, ethics, contractor responsibilities, and Sedimentation Pollution Control Act.
exams.jurisdiction: state (State Licensing Board for General Contractors)
exams.quote: the examination shall establish (i) the ability of the applicant to make a practical application of the applicant's knowledge of the profession of contracting

exams.name: Plumbing, Heating, or Fire Sprinkler Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Two-part exam: business and law portion and a technical portion. Applicants who fail may not be reexamined for 90 days; failing three times may require additional education or one-year wait.
exams.jurisdiction: state (State Board of Examiners of Plumbing, Heating, and Fire Sprinkler Contractors)
exams.quote: the Board shall give an examination designed to ascertain the technical and practical knowledge of the applicant concerning the analysis of plans and specifications, estimating costs, fundamentals of installation and design, codes, fire hazards, and related subjects as these subjects pertain to plumbing, heating, or fire sprinkler systems

approximate.matched_normalized: d shall give an examination designed to ascertain the technical and practical knowledge of the applicant concerning the analysis of plans and specifications estimating costs fundamentals of installation and design codes fire hazards and related subjects as these subjects pertain to plumbing heating or fire sprinkler systems

exams.name: Electrical Contractor Qualifying Individual Examination
exams.notes: Covers National Electrical Code, analysis of electrical plans and specifications, estimating, and fundamentals of electrical installation.
exams.jurisdiction: state (State Board of Examiners of Electrical Contractors)
exams.quote: the State Board of Examiners of Electrical Contractors shall provide for the written examination of all applicants for certification as a qualified individual

exams.name: Refrigeration Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Regular examinations given by appointment at the Board's office.
exams.quote: the Board shall give an examination designed to ascertain the technical and practical knowledge of the applicant concerning the analysis of plans and specifications, estimating cost, fundamentals of installation and design as they pertain to refrigeration

approximate.matched_normalized: d shall give an examination designed to ascertain the technical and practical knowledge of the applicant concerning the analysis of plans and specifications estimating cost fundamentals of installation and design as they pertain to refrigeration

exams.name: Well Contractor Certification Examination
exams.notes: Persons 70+ with 20+ years experience and clean record are exempt from examination.
exams.quote: the Commission, with the advice and assistance of the Secretary, shall establish minimum requirements of education, experience, and knowledge for each type of certification for well contractors and shall establish procedures for receiving applications for certification, conducting examinations

interval_years.quote: A license shall expire on the first day of January following its issuance or renewal and shall become invalid 60 days from that date unless renewed

required.quote: at least one qualifier or qualifying party of a licensee holding a building contractor, residential contractor, or unclassified contractor license classification shall complete, on an annual basis, eight hours of continuing education approved in accordance with this section

value: 2 hours mandatory course approved by the Board

topical_requirements.quote: two hours shall be a mandatory course approved by the Board and the remaining six hours shall be elective courses approved by the Board

available.quote: the Board in its discretion may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to general contractors licensed by other states, without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the Board that the qualifications of such applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in North Carolina

requirements.value: To the extent other states provide for licensing of general contractors and provide for similar reciprocal action; applicant must show qualifications equal to NC licensees and pay the required fee.
requirements.quote: To the extent that other states which provide for the licensing of general contractors provide for similar action, the Board in its discretion may grant licenses of the same or equivalent classification to general contractors licensed by other states, without written examination upon satisfactory proof furnished to the Board that the qualifications of such applicants are equal to the qualifications of holders of similar licenses in North Carolina and upon payment of the required fee.

regulatory_model.quote: Any person, firm, or corporation not being duly authorized who shall contract for or bid upon the construction of any of the projects or works enumerated in G.S. 87-1, without having first complied with the provisions hereof, or who shall attempt to practice general contracting in the State, except as provided for in this Article ... shall be deemed guilty of a Class 2 misdemeanor.

scope__voidable_contract_clauses.item: Liability limitation clause (limiting contractor liability to cost of inspection report or contract price)
Indemnification / hold-harmless clause favoring the promisee's sole negligence
Waiver of consumer cancellation rights clause
Waiver of consumer rights (general statutory rights) clause
Blank spaces clause (material terms left blank for later completion)
Assignment of insurance proceeds clause (without owner consent / in violation of statutory requirements)
Clause authorizing unlawful entry or breach of peace for repossession
Lien disclosure notice omission (failure to include required lien disclosure)
Disclaimer or limitation of implied warranty clause
Clause entered into by unlicensed contractor (contract with unlicensed contractor)
Clause requiring compliance waiver from applicable building codes or zoning regulations
Distributed energy contract clause failing to meet statutory disclosure or terms requirements
